discovery_port_taken: Another program holds the announcement port: this node announces itself to your machines, but doesn't see theirs.
discovery_unavailable: Automatic discovery unavailable ({error}). Adding by address still works.
port_unavailable: Port {port} is unavailable: the network couldn't start.
port_held_self: Port {port} is still held by this node: restart AIODOS to get it back. Meanwhile, it uses port {spare}.
port_held_phone: Another AIODOS (“{name}”) is running on this phone and holds port {port}: probably the old Termux node; restarting the phone is enough. Meanwhile, this node uses port {spare}.
port_held_by_node: Another AIODOS (“{name}”) is open on this device and holds port {port}: close it if you don't need it (another copy of AIODOS, a test node…). Meanwhile, this node uses port {spare}.
port_taken: Port {port} is taken by another program: this node uses port {spare}, which it announces to your machines.
own_address: That's the address of this very machine.
public_unsupported: This version's Internet companion doesn't know the public network yet: it will come with the next update.
public_needs_internet: First turn on “Internet”: the public network goes through it.
machine_not_found: Machine not found on the network.
